snippet.title: Yet Another Zombie Survivors 1.0 - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2163330/
Xbox One & Series: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/yazs/9NCK0FXQL38F
PlayStation 4/5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10010467
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/yet_another_zombie_survivors
____________

Yet Another Zombie Survivors 1.0 is OUT! 🧟

We packed 4 major updates' worth of new content into one release. 

New Survivor, map, game mode, HUB, missions, synergies, Torments, friendship system and a whole lot more!

Assemble your team and decide upon their enhancements to find the most efficient synergies against thousands of the undead!

What makes #YAZS stand out among other similar titles?

Control a 3-member squad - unlike most games in the genre, you can play up to three Survivors in a single run.
Create wild synergies - unlock Survivors, combine their abilities, and experiment with powerful team compositions across multiple game modes.
Build your playstyle - level up and choose perks, abilities, and nodes from 9 skill- trees.
Explore more than just combat - the 1.0 update introduces quests, story content, and a HUB area that gives players a place to return to between runs.
Fight new challenges - face arena bosses, complete challenges, and unlock new achievements.
Enjoy the humor - keep an eye out for puns and easter eggs hidden absolutely everywhere.
Community-driven development - YAZS has been shaped by regular updates and player feedback throughout Early Access with more content updates coming in the future.
